subject: Portal onboarding: signature routing, PO acknowledgement SLA, and contract redlines
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@procureplus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medsupplies.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding / MSA redlines + PO/portal questions

Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. Attached is our questionnaire and the edits our procurement counsel made to the MSA (Redline_MSA_ProcurePlus_v3.docx). Before we start the Coupa connector work, a couple of quick asks so we can scope the integration properly:

- We need confirmation of the PO acknowledgement SLA (our platform expects a PO ack within 72 hours by default). Can Redwood commit to that for this account or propose a fallback?
- Which billing entity should appear on the PO (legal name + tax ID)?
- We use Coupa (not Ariba) and will want to map line-level SKU->Redwood SKU. Do you have an OrderForm_FieldMap template we can load?
- Signature routing: do you support signer delegation (e.g., procurement signs, ops signs for invoices) or do you require a single signatory? If delegation is supported, can you share an example matrix?

Samir (cc) — can you confirm whether ProcurePlus requires EDI acknowledgements or a webhook for PO creation?

Appreciate it,

Marta Ruiz
Procurement Director | ProcurePlus
marta.ruiz@procureplus.com

[Attachment: Redline_MSA_ProcurePlus_v3.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@procureplus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / MSA redlines + PO/portal questions

Marta — thanks for the redline and the clear asks. Looping in Kimberly from legal and Marissa from onboarding/ops to align next steps. Summary and our asks below.

What we can confirm now:
- Portal: Redwood supports Coupa connectors and can map line-level SKUs. We will provide an OrderForm_FieldMap.xlsx template for ProcurePlus to populate. (Attached: OrderForm_FieldMap.xlsx)
- PO acknowledgement: our standard SLA for new accounts is 72 hours for PO acknowledgement via portal. We can commit to 72 hours for this initial rollout; if volume or custom routing is required we will document a fallback policy in the onboarding plan.
- Billing entity: please confirm the exact legal entity name + EIN you want on the PO. Our standard invoice flow will use that entity.
- Signature delegation: we support delegated signer routing via our order form metadata (we call this the "signature delegation matrix"). Kimberly, can you confirm any legal constraints here?

Proposed action items:
1) Kimberly: quick redline read — highlight any nonstandard MSA asks that block activation (we will need to know whether to accept, counter, or escalate).
2) Marissa: I will schedule a 30-min mapping call with ProcurePlus + Samir to walk through OrderForm_FieldMap and webhook/EDI options. Suggested times below.
3) Marta/Samir: please populate the OrderForm_FieldMap.xlsx where possible and confirm billing entity.

We can target activation runbook v1 by next Thursday if we get the populated map and signatory matrix by Monday COB.

Thanks,

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Partner Lead, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: OrderForm_FieldMap.xlsx]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@procureplus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medsupplies.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / MSA redlines + PO/portal questions

Karthik — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications: 

- Confirming Coupa. ProcurePlus will require EDI 850 for POs and 855 for acknowledgements; however we can also accept a webhook if Redwood prefers to surface acknowledgements via an endpoint — Samir, can confirm.
- PO ack SLA: 72 hours is acceptable. We'll note the fallback policy in the onboarding checklist.
- Billing entity: ProcurePlus, Inc. — EIN 12-3456789. Please include exactly that string on POs.
- Signature delegation: we do have a multi-role signatory model (Procurement, Legal, Finance). I've attached a sample delegation matrix (Signature_Delegation_Matrix.pdf) — our legal team prefers delegation metadata rather than separate executed amendment.

I've started populating OrderForm_FieldMap.xlsx with our SKU mappings and a couple of line-item examples. I'll bring the completed sheet to the mapping call.

Marta
Marta Ruiz | Procurement Director, ProcurePlus
marta.ruiz@procureplus.com

[Attachment: Signature_Delegation_Matrix.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / MSA redlines + PO/portal questions

Marta / Karthik — thanks for the materials. Quick legal read and recommended path: 

1) MSA redlines: Reviewed Redline_MSA_ProcurePlus_v3.docx. Most edits are standard procurement language clarifications; there are three items that need explicit approval from our commercial team before acceptance (Section 7 liability cap carve, Section 12 data residency addendum, and the indemnity carve related to third-party tooling). Karthik — I recommend a short internal sync with commercial to accept two of these and escalate the indemnity carve.

2) Signature delegation: legal is comfortable allowing delegation metadata on the Order Form provided the matrix is explicit about role, sign authority thresholds, and delegation dates. We can accept the Signature_Delegation_Matrix.pdf approach if ProcurePlus will populate the fields in the OrderForm_FieldMap (we will store the delegation metadata in the order metadata). No separate amendment required.

3) PO ack and EDI/webhook: technical/ops confirm Redwood can send 855 acknowledgements via EDI; if ProcurePlus prefers webhooks we will spin up a short-lived endpoint for the pilot. For production we recommend EDI for guaranteed delivery.

Next steps (owned):
- Kimberly: finalize legal positions on the three flagged MSA items and provide proposed counterlanguage by EOD Monday (legal redline comment summary).
- Karthik/Marissa: proceed with mapping call — Marissa please send calendar invites for Monday 10:00am or Tuesday 2:00pm PT.
- Marta/Samir: finish the OrderForm_FieldMap.xlsx and return by Monday 5:00pm PT.

If we get the populated map and signatory matrix by Monday COB and legal provides the counterlanguage, we should be able to complete the activation runbook and schedule a merchant test by Wednesday next week.

Regards,

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
